review.tagline: Claude Code plugin with 67 role-based skills and 9 Jira-linked workflow commands
review.summary: A Claude Code plugin that installs 67 skills covering languages, frameworks, infrastructure, testing, DevOps and security. Skills activate from the request text and load per-topic reference files (371 in total). It also ships 9 workflow commands for managing epics with Jira and Confluence, and a /common-ground command that surfaces Claude's assumptions about the project.
review.audience: Claude Code users wanting ready-made full-stack skills and Jira workflows
strengths: Installs through the Claude Code plugin marketplace with two commands
Skills activate from the request and load only the relevant reference file
Covers 12 categories, from languages to security and data/ML
Documented multi-skill workflows, e.g. feature development through code review
weaknesses: Built for Claude Code; support for other agents is not stated
Workflow commands require an Atlassian MCP server to be set up
Quality and overlap across 67 skills cannot be judged from the README
Skills are prompt text, so results depend on the model used
needs: Needs Claude Code, Atlassian MCP server (workflow commands only)
